criteria: The shared protocol defines exact task/group scope, dependency-ordered question rounds, source facts, actual owner answers, guarded revisions and interruption/resume.
Completion requires concrete goals, scope, dependencies, acceptance and feasible validation, no unresolved mandatory decisions and actual owner confirmation bound to the current task revision.
The shared loop derives from the inspected upstream grilling protocol and supports explicit clarification without a generic plugin engine; the planned post-processing adapter reuses the same loop.

The contract separates complete-content write guards from semantic confirmation identity; formatting-only edits preserve confirmation, semantic edits reopen affected answers and final confirmation, and unrelated answers remain valid.
limitations: Static current contract revalidation only; no new host/native execution or revised terminal outcome is claimed.
observations: Exact unique selected T identities, canonical session isolation and parked state neutrality remain explicit.

clarification_questions/clarification_round retain prerequisite frontier and current clarity; clarification_evidence accepts actual owner-message/submitted-answer evidence rather than recommendations or silence.
clarification_guard/revise/mutate retain complete-content/session guards, exact task/provenance preservation and current exact-scope/semantic confirmation.
clarification_semantics/invalidate retain formatting equivalence, affected-answer reopening and unrelated answers.
The inspected pinned upstream grilling derivation and shared explicit loop remain separate from the future generic plugin adapter.
The new cached plugin-generation admission guard affects implementation admission, supplies no answers and removes no clarification hold.
Current W1 Auto/Manual policy remains approved future implementation; the current manual controller and original terminal outcome remain unchanged.
